info.name: Lukeflow — Capability Engine API (via authdev gateway)
info.description:
Capability-engine API reached through the **luke-auth-engine gateway** at **https://authdev.lukeflow.com**.

## Getting a token
Run **`0 · Sign in → Login`** (POST `/auth/login` with `email`/`password`). It returns `{ accessToken, session }` and the test script stores `accessToken` as the `authToken` collection variable + `session.tenant` as `tenantId`. Every other request sends `Authorization: Bearer {{authToken}}` (collection-level auth). The gateway verifies that token and mints its own internal act-as badge — you never handle that badge.

If your account is SSO-only (`/auth/login` returns `sso_required`), sign in via the Lukeflow UI and copy the `Authorization: Bearer …` value from a network request into `authToken`.

Tokens are short-lived — re-run **Login** or **Refresh** on a 401.

## Scope
Folders 1–6 are the routes the gateway actually proxies (catalog, my-access, form definitions, form instances, public embed, health). The active tenant is sent via `X-Tenant-Id`; the user identity comes from the token, so no `X-User-Id` is needed.

Folder 7 holds the privileged admin routes (`/api/tenants/**`, `/api/users/**`) which are **NOT** reachable through the gateway — they require hitting capability-engine directly with the operator Basic credential. See that folder's notes.

item.name: 0 · Sign in (gateway)
item.description:
Authenticate against the gateway and capture the WorkOS access token used as Bearer by every other request.

Run **Login** first: it stores `authToken` (and `tenantId` from your session) automatically. The token is short-lived — re-run **Login** or **Refresh** when calls start returning 401.

request.description: POST /auth/login → { accessToken, sid, user, session }. Stores accessToken as {{authToken}} and session.tenant as {{tenantId}}. (If your account is SSO-only, use the Lukeflow UI to sign in and copy the Bearer token instead.)

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.accessToken != null) pm.collectionVariables.set("authToken", j.accessToken); } catch (e) {}
try { const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.session.tenant != null) pm.collectionVariables.set("tenantId", j.session.tenant); } catch (e) {}
try { const t = pm.response.json().session?.tenants; if (t && t.length && !pm.collectionVariables.get("tenantId")) pm.collectionVariables.set("tenantId", t[0]); } catch (e) {}

request.description: POST /auth/refresh → new access token from the HttpOnly refresh cookie set at login. Re-stores {{authToken}}.

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.accessToken != null) pm.collectionVariables.set("authToken", j.accessToken); } catch (e) {}

request.description: GET /session → userId, tenant(s), roles, capabilities. Confirms the token works and shows what the user can do.

item.name: 1 · Capability catalog
item.description: Platform-wide capability catalog, addressed by stable business code (FORMS, CALENDAR, …). Proxied through the gateway; writes may be operator-gated upstream.

item.name: 2 · My access (tenant + user)
item.description: Caller-scoped reads. Identity comes from the Bearer token (the gateway mints the act-as badge); the active tenant comes from X-Tenant-Id.

item.name: 3 · Form definitions
item.description: Authoring, versioning (check-in → publish), edit-lock, clone, lifecycle. Tenant-scoped via X-Tenant-Id; gated by the FORMS capability (GET=read, mutations=read-write). Run 'Create form' first — it stores {{formId}} and {{formCode}}.

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.id != null) pm.collectionVariables.set("formId", j.id); } catch (e) {}
try { const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.code != null) pm.collectionVariables.set("formCode", j.code); } catch (e) {}

request.description: Compiles the draft into a new immutable version. First check-in auto-publishes; pass publish=true to publish later ones. Schema is optional (falls back to the stored draft).
Mints a signed embed token (requires a published version). Stored as {{embedToken}} for the Public embed folder.

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.token != null) pm.collectionVariables.set("embedToken", j.token); } catch (e) {}

item.name: 4 · Form instances
item.description: Runtime occurrences of a published form version. Tenant-scoped via X-Tenant-Id. States: CREATED→SENT→OPENED→IN_PROGRESS→SUBMITTED→PROCESSED (plus EXPIRED, CANCELLED). 'Create instance' stores {{instanceId}} and {{instanceToken}}.

request.description: definitionCode is required. version defaults to the form's published version. expiresAt is epoch millis.

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.instance.id != null) pm.collectionVariables.set("instanceId", j.instance.id); } catch (e) {}
try { const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.instance.token != null) pm.collectionVariables.set("instanceToken", j.instance.token); } catch (e) {}

item.name: 5 · Public embed (unauthenticated)
item.description: The public iframe + inbound-webhook surface — the only path that needs no gateway token. The signed embed token in the path IS the auth. Get one from '3 · Form definitions → Get embed token' (stored as {{embedToken}}).

request.description: Records a SUBMITTED instance and best-effort starts the intake process. Rate-limited to 20/min per token.

item.name: 7 · Admin — direct to engine (NOT via gateway)
item.description:
⚠️ These privileged routes are NOT exposed through https://authdev.lukeflow.com — the gateway/core-engine proxy does not forward /api/tenants/** or /api/users/**, and the gateway overwrites Authorization so Basic auth can't pass through.

They are server-to-server (core-engine → capability-engine). To exercise them you must hit the capability-engine instance DIRECTLY using {{engineDirectUrl}} with the operator HTTP Basic credential ({{operatorUser}}/{{operatorPassword}}). Set those variables first.

request.description: level must be 'read' or 'read-write'. 409 if the tenant is not subscribed to the capability.
Under /api/users/** — not behind the operator filter (which scopes to /api/tenants/**).
